title: CommitDetail
description: A commit with the files it changed, against its first parent.

from.description: The old path, relative to the folder, `/`-separated.

oneOf.description: Both sides of a merge changed it.

at.description: When it was authored, in seconds since the Unix epoch.

author.description: The author's name, as git records it.

parents.description: Its parents, first parent first; empty for a root commit.

subject.description: The first line of the message.

CommitId.description: A full object id: 40 (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256) lowercase hex characters.

Seconds.description:
A duration or a point on a monotonic timeline, in seconds.

`f64` keeps sub-microsecond precision over multi-day sessions, which `f32` can't (it loses milliseconds after
about 4.6 hours).
